Title: Karan's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Karan - 30 years, prince, son
Look: golden crown, red royal robe
2. Pallavi - 28 years, princess, daughter
Look: small crown, pink lehenga
3. Hema - 55 years, queen, mother
Look: small crown, pink lehenga

Places

1. The training ground - an earth ground, a rack of weapons
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The forest - tall trees, thick bushes
4. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots

Scene 1: The training ground - Day

[Karan stands on the training ground. Pallavi and Hema stand near him.]

Karan: "Let's do something fun today."

[Karan practises sword fighting.]

Karan (excited): "Yes, all right."

[Karan draws his bow and shoots an arrow at the target.]

Karan (gently): "Exactly right."

[Karan mounts his horse and gallops away.]

Hema (softly): "Oh wow!"

[Karan swings his sword from the saddle of his horse.]

Pallavi (gently): "Wow, how lovely!"

[Karan shoots an arrow from his galloping horse.]

Karan: "Oh wow!"

[Pallavi rides into the training ground on her horse.]

Pallavi: "Yes, of course."

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Karan stands in the living room. Hema stands near him.]

Karan: "What a nice place."

[Karan pours himself a whisky and drinks it.]

Karan: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Karan sips red wine.]

Karan: "Oh wow!"

[Karan drinks a beer.]

Hema: "That's easy."

[Karan staggers drunkenly towards the door.]

Hema: "That's easy."

[Karan and Mother clink their glasses.]

Karan: "Yes, of course."

[Karan walks slowly across the room while talking on the phone.]

Karan (softly): "And then?"

Scene 3: The forest - Day

Karan: "What a nice place."

[Karan goes hunting and aims his bow at a deer.]

Karan: "I knew it!"

[Karan rides an elephant through the forest.]

Pallavi: "Wow, how lovely!"

Scene 4: The kitchen - Day

[Pallavi stands in the kitchen. Hema and Karan stand near her.]

Karan: "Let's begin."

[Pallavi rolls out rotis on the board.]

Hema (happily): "I knew it!"

[Pallavi stirs the dal in the pot.]

Pallavi (gently): "I really enjoyed today."
